pr_title: Fix toggling storyboard after first load not getting correct clock
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/5280
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/5305

Previously, toggling a storyboard in the middle of a map without prior loading will successfully load the storyboard, but it will never get the `GameplayClock` via DI because it'll be loaded before it can be added to the draw hierarchy. 

This creates a new `StoryboardContainer` that has the correct dependencies needed for `DrawableStoryboard`, and loads the storyboard inside this new class.
pr_comments: I'm very confused by this. Can you explain your findings better? What doesn't get the `GameplayClock` and why?

`DrawableStoryboard` is being loaded asynchronously in the case of loading after gameplay has started, and is only added to the hierarchy inside `initializeStoryboard` of `Player` once loading has completed. `DrawableStoryboard` DI's in the `GameplayClock`, but because it hasn't been added yet it can't resolve it.
The correct fix would then be to call `LoadComponentAsync` on `StoryboardContainer`, rather than `Player`
I'm guessing you mean rather than the `DrawableStoryboard`?
the `LoadComponentAsync` call needs to be executed on the `StoryboardContainer`, where the correct dependencies are.
Ah, I see. Will give that a try.
Personally not sure about calling them `DimmableStoryboard` and `DimmableBackground`, since my first thought about these types is they are actual `Storyboard`s and `Background`s
Against calling them containers as they should never be used as a container. They handle their children internally.
@smoogipoo leaving for your perusal since i made considerable changes.

issue_context.title: Storyboard switcher only works one way
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
You can disable the storyboard if you enabled it when the beatmap was loading, and then reenable it again, but you can't do the opposite, black screen comes up. Video shows how the bug could be recreated.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3l2yBSHg0U8

**osu!lazer version:** 
2019.704.0
comments: It seems like the toggle *does* work, but playback starts at a point far too late in the storyboard.

This will fail if you reassign the same background, as it will try to add an expired `Drawable`.
